last.verdict: Shares edged up as a $39M asset sale and wind-down left little upside.

reasons.label: Company being sold
reasons.text: Agreed to sell its brand and assets to American Exchange Group for about $39 million.

reasons.label: Payout, not growth
reasons.text: Sale proceeds are expected to go to shareholders in Q3, so the business itself isn't the story.

reasons.label: Modest premium to price
reasons.text: Shares closed at $2.98 (a $24.5M market cap) before the news, so $39M was a premium.

story: Revenue kept shrinking: down 22% in 2024's fourth quarter and 23% in Q3 2025, with guidance cut and going-concern doubt raised. By March 2026 the company chose a sale and wind-down over turning things around.
